newsitem.title: USA: Banyan Strategic Land secures financing.
newsitem.headline: Banyan Strategic Land secures financing.

text.p: Banyan Strategic Land Fund II on Wednesday said it entered an agreement with Equis Financial Group and its Equis Exchange affiliate that provides financing for Banyan's new growth-oriented business plan.
Under the agreement, Banyan issued about 2.0 million shares of its common stock in exchange for about $3 million, or $1.50 a share. In addition, Equis Exchange loaned Banyan $4.4 million.

Banyan said its annual meeting would take place later this year to solicit shareholder consent to change the name of the company and amend its governance documents to conform with those of more traditional operating company.
If the consent is obtained by October 31, Banyan said it would declare a one-time cash distribution to shareholders of $0.20 a share.
As part of the deal, one of Equis Financial's principals, Gary Engle, was added to Banyan's board of directors and another, James Coyne, became Banyan's chief operating officer.
Also, Banyan will enter a new administrative services agreement with an affiliate of Equis Finanical, which is based in Boston.

Proceeds from the loan are not immediately available to Banyan. If the shareholder consent is received, the loan will be disbursed to the company with the interest rate set at 10 percent a year with a fixed term of three years.
Mandatory principal reductions will be required if net proceeds are received from the sale or refinancing of Banyan's Rancho Malibu property, Banyan said.
Banyan shares were unchanged at 29/32 early Wednesday afternoon.
